welcome.title: Welcome to the service (referred to as "the Service"). By accessing or using the Service, you agree to comply with these Terms of Service ("Terms"). If you do not agree, please discontinue use of the Service.

useOfService.title: Use of the Service
useOfService.content: The Service provides information about conditions for wild edibles (Terra) and advice for vegetable gardens based on weather forecasts and climate data (Huerta). The information is for general guidance only and is not guaranteed to be accurate, complete, or up-to-date.

foragingDisclaimer.title: Foraging Disclaimer
foragingDisclaimer.content: The Service includes recipes and information about wild edible plants, berries, nuts, and mushrooms. While every effort is made to ensure accuracy, the safe consumption of wild edibles depends entirely on correct identification, appropriate preparation, and individual health conditions.
foragingDisclaimer.misidentification: Misidentification of wild plants or fungi can lead to allergic reactions, poisoning, or other serious health consequences. Some edible species have toxic lookalikes. Always consult a local expert or use an authoritative guide when identifying wild edibles, and do not consume anything unless you are 100% certain of its safety.
foragingDisclaimer.preparation: Additionally, some wild edibles should only be consumed in small quantities or after specific preparation methods to neutralize naturally occurring compounds. Recipes provided by the Service are for educational purposes and assume correct identification and proper handling of ingredients.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer of Liability
disclaimer.content: You use the Service at your own risk. Conditions in natural environments may change unexpectedly, and you are responsible for exercising caution and judgment when planning or undertaking activities based on information provided by the Service.

noProfessionalAdvice.content: The information provided by the Service is not intended to substitute professional advice, including but not limited to safety, health, or environmental guidance. Always consult local authorities or experts before undertaking outdoor activities.

huerta.title: Gardening Advice
huerta.content: Huerta’s advice, including frost warnings, sowing and planting times, watering and care steps, is worked out from weather forecasts and long-term climate data for the area around your garden. Forecasts can be wrong, and conditions in your garden may differ from those of the area.
huerta.frost: Frost warnings and other alerts may be wrong, late, or not arrive at all. Protect the plants that matter to you on your own judgement; the administrator is not liable for lost or damaged crops.

accounts.title: Huerta Accounts
accounts.content: Huerta needs an account, which you create by signing in with a Google account. An account is for one person aged 16 or over. Keep the devices you are signed in on secure.
accounts.conduct: The administrator may suspend or delete accounts that misuse the Service or break these Terms.
accounts.delete: You can delete your account at any time in Settings → Huerta account; the Privacy Policy explains what is deleted.

earlyAccess.title: Early Access
earlyAccess.content: Huerta is in early access: it is free, and features may change, be added or be removed while it develops.
earlyAccess.price: If that changes, you’ll be told in the app first, and nothing is charged without your agreement.
